slides.text: Welcome everyone to the Agent Commerce Hackathon. This weekend you will build software that agents can discover, pay for, and use on their own.
There are three tracks. Primitive plus Stripe covers agent payments and messaging. Manufact is for shipping an MCP server. And the overall winner gets a Y Combinator interview.
The most important slide. Submissions are due Sunday at ten A M. You need a GitHub repository link and a two minute demo video. Late submissions will not be judged.
Finally, logistics. The Wi-Fi network is hack guest, and the password is on your badge. Dinner is at seven P M on the second floor. Judging starts Sunday at eleven, and finalists present at two P M.
